value.rationale: The exact regular-polygon construction attains the absolute dimension lower bound for harmonic polynomial recovery from complete local spatial k-jets for every L,k. Its rank formula quantifies every undersampling defect and supports direct FFT/Vandermonde reconstruction. The sharp sensor-count improvement relative to same-order tangential-only data is mathematically motivated by distinct holomorphic and antiholomorphic channels; this is neither an arbitrary numerical slice nor a trivial renaming of a known table.
